skill.summary: Estimate calorie content from food names, portion sizes, or food images.

latestVersion.changelog:
Calorie Compass 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Estimates calorie content from food names, portion sizes, or uploaded food images.
- Supports calculations for individual items and full meals with multiple components.
- Understands common quantity formats (grams, cups, slices, bowls, etc.).
- Provides flexible, reasoned calorie estimates, clarifying assumptions and possible variations.
- Delivers total and per-item calories, and may provide basic macronutrient data when details allow.
